_note: uv sync --extra crafter (crafter-gym, gym/crafter/, pulls crafter), then pip install --force-reinstall 'crafter @ git+https://github.com/chengfanbrain/crafter.git@deterministic' -- a fork of 1.8.3 whose single change is that a seed plus an action list replays exactly (see _state_note). Plain PyPI crafter runs this config fine and plays identically to a subject, but its blocks cannot be replayed, so a model cannot be given the same episode. This is the paradigm's level 4 (survival): hostiles on, health/food/drink/energy decay, death ends the episode, nothing hidden from the HUD. It is stock crafter, rule for rule: what is written down below is the interface it is played through and the pacing, not the game. Levels 1-3 freeze or remove parts of the game and belong in a gymnasium.Wrapper shipped with the env, as the menu is (gym/crafter/crafter_gym/menu.py): a level an adapter applied would stop humans and models from playing the same game.
